commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a caution score of 46 following the RBI's 25 bps repo rate hike and persistent FII cash outflows surpassing ₹6,100 crore, benchmark indices are undergoing confirmed distribution below 22,400. In strict accordance with Stan Weinstein's stage analysis and William O'Neil's market-direction rules, aggressive capital commitment must be curtailed. When market averages face institutional selling, breakout failure rates multiply even for Stage 2 structures. Discipline requires Mark Minervini's progressive exposure strategy: keep position sizes defensive, enforce strict stop discipline, and demand accelerating CANSLIM earnings before committing risk capital.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Darvas Box Discipline

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Consolidates in a tight 30-session Darvas box near pivot resistance, holding above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Dual swing lows indicate supply absorption, but the setup lacks relative strength leadership in a hostile tape.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severely impaired CANSLIM profile as Q1 revenue collapsed 56.3% YoY and net profit dropped 25.6% to ₹1.02 Cr. Weak multi-year ROE near 3.1% and fragile interest coverage provide no institutional cushion.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails on a breakdown below 99.05 stop; cut immediately as poor fundamentals increase down-gap risk.

ABDL.technical: Forms a double bottom above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, pressing neckline resistance. RSI at 70 and MACD above zero reflect positive momentum, but breakout execution is vulnerable to broad market distribution.
ABDL.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue rose modestly by 6.1% YoY to ₹978.9 Cr, but net profit contracted 18.7% to ₹45.4 Cr due to margin compression. Subdued ROE and negative earnings momentum fail CANSLIM standards.
ABDL.risk: Stop strictly at 693.33; close below violates the double-bottom base floor, requiring swift liquidation.

ACE.technical: Displays constructive Stage 2 advancing structure within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot. Two aligned swing lows provide a tight base above rising 21-EMA and 50-SMA, with MACD supporting continuation.
ACE.fundamental: Operational revenue grew 20.5% YoY to ₹785.7 Cr with net profit advancing 22.3% to ₹119.5 Cr. Healthy operating margins near 14.9%, debt-free status, and robust ROCE of 31.6% provide solid fundamental support.
ACE.risk: Invalidated if price breaches 1,184.64 stop; close below the swing low violates base integrity, triggering immediate exit.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Exhibits Stage 2 power, pulling back constructively to the rising 21-EMA near recent highs before producing a bullish reclaim candle. RSI at 63 reflects unextended strength, with price well above 50-SMA and 200-SMA.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Outstanding Q1 FY27 expansion with revenue jumping 67.8% YoY to ₹857.5 Cr and net profit surging 79.9% to ₹235.3 Cr, driven by battery storage integration and record CUF. Expanding margins offset balance sheet leverage.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Thesis fails on a drop below 435.78 stop; breach of the 21-EMA invalidates the reclaim pattern.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Large-cap leader respecting Stage 2 uptrend, rebounding off its rising 21-EMA with two aligned swing lows. Price sits above all key moving averages, though RSI at 58 indicates consolidation rather than explosive leadership.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 18.6% YoY to ₹10,820.8 Cr with strong 60% EBITDA margins. However, net profit growth moderated to 9.2% YoY, and elevated debt of ₹56,776 Cr warrants caution under tighter monetary conditions.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Violated on a break below 1,771.57 stop; breach of recent swing lows signals institutional liquidation.

ADFFOODS.technical: Cleared prior 20-session highs on an explosive SEPA breakout backed by 4.45× 20-day average volume. Moving averages are stacked positively above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA with positive MACD.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Sales expanded 23.9% YoY to ₹168.4 Cr on robust packaged ethnic food demand, but PAT growth decelerated to 13.5% YoY to ₹17.3 Cr. Clean balance sheet and strong ROCE of 21.8% maintain operational stability.
ADFFOODS.risk: Breakout fails if price slips below 308.38 stop; cut losses immediately to avoid holding a failed breakout.
